021import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.economy.benefit.BenefitProvider;
022import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.localization.text.ProxiedLocale;
023import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.obj.QUser;
024import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.IShopType;
025import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.state.ShopState;
026import net.kyori.adventure.text.Component;
027import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
028import org.jetbrains.annotations.ApiStatus;
029import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
030import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
031
032import java.util.UUID;
033
034/**
035 * ShopIdentity
036 *
037 * @author creatorfromhell
038 * @since 6.3.0.0
039 */
040public interface ShopMeta<U> extends ShopPrice<U> {
041
042  /**
043   * WARNING: This UUID will changed after plugin reload, shop reload or server restart DO NOT USE
044   * IT TO STORE DATA!
045   *
046   * @return Random UUID
047   */
048  @NotNull
049  UUID getRuntimeRandomUniqueId();
050
051  /**
052   * Gets the Shop ID to identify the shop.
053   *
054   * @return Shop ID -1 if shop in creating state.
055   */
056  long getShopId();
057
058  /**
059   * Internal Only: Give shop that under id_waiting state an ShopId.
060   *
061   * @param newId The new shop id, once set will cannot change anymore.
062   */
063  @ApiStatus.Internal
064  void setShopId(long newId);
065
066  /**
067   * Gets this shop name that set by player
068   *
069   * @return Shop name, or null if not set
070   */
071  @Nullable
072  String getShopName();
073
074  /**
075   * Sets shop name
076   *
077   * @param shopName shop name, null to remove currently name
078   */
079  void setShopName(@Nullable String shopName);
080
081  /**
082   * Get shop item's ItemStack
083   *
084   * @return The shop's ItemStack
085   */
086  @NotNull
087  ItemStack getItem();
088
089  /**
090   * Set shop item's ItemStack
091   *
092   * @param item ItemStack to set
093   */
094  void setItem(@NotNull ItemStack item);
095
096  /**
097   * Gets the currency that shop use
098   *
099   * @return The currency name
100   */
101  @Nullable
102  String getCurrency();
103
104  /**
105   * Sets the currency that shop use
106   *
107   * @param currency The currency name; null to use default currency
108   */
109  void setCurrency(@Nullable String currency);
110
111  /**
112   * Get shop's price
113   *
114   * @return Price
115   * @deprecated Use {@link ShopPrice#price()} instead
116   */
117  @Deprecated(forRemoval = true, since = "6.3.0.0")
118  double getPrice();
119
120  /**
121   * Set shop's new price
122   *
123   * @param paramDouble New price
124   * @deprecated Use {@link ShopPrice#price(Object)} instead.
125   */
126  @Deprecated(forRemoval = true, since = "6.3.0.0")
127  void setPrice(double paramDouble);
128
129  /**
130   * Retrieves the current state of the shop.
131   *
132   * @return the current state of the shop as a ShopState object
133   */
134  ShopState shopState();
135
136  /**
137   * Updates the current state of the shop based on the provided {@code ShopState}.
138   *
139   * @param state the new state to set for the shop; must not be null
140   */
141  void shopState(@NotNull ShopState state);
142
143  /**
144   * Updates or processes the state of a shop based on the provided identifier.
145   *
146   * @param shopStateIdentifier a non-null string representing the unique identifier
147   *                             for the shop state to be updated or processed.
148   */
149  void shopState(@NotNull String shopStateIdentifier);
150
151  /**
152   * Retrieves the type of shop associated with this entity.
153   *
154   * @return an instance of IShopType representing the shop type
155   */
156  IShopType shopType();
157
158  /**
159   * Sets the type of shop using the provided shop type parameter.
160   *
161   * @param newShopType the shop type to set, must not be null
162   */
163  void shopType(@NotNull IShopType newShopType);
164
165  /**
166   * Specifies the type of shop based on the given identifier.
167   *
168   * @param shopTypeIdentifier the identifier representing the type of shop. Must not be null.
169   */
170  void shopType(@NotNull String shopTypeIdentifier);
171
172  /**
173   * Get shop's owner name, it will return owner name or Admin Shop(i18n) when it is unlimited
174   *
175   * @param forceUsername Force returns username of shop
176   * @param locale        The locale to parse the message
177   *
178   * @return owner name
179   */
180  @NotNull
181  Component ownerName(boolean forceUsername, @NotNull ProxiedLocale locale);
182
183  /**
184   * Get shop's owner name, it will return owner name or Admin Shop(i18n) when it is unlimited
185   *
186   * @param locale The locale to parse the message
187   *
188   * @return owner name
189   */
190  @NotNull
191  Component ownerName(@NotNull ProxiedLocale locale);
192
193  /**
194   * Get shop's owner name, it will return owner name or Admin Shop(i18n) when it is unlimited
195   *
196   * @return owner name
197   */
198  @NotNull
199  Component ownerName();
200
201
202  /**
203   * Get shop's owner QUser
204   *
205   * @return Shop's owner QUser object, can use Bukkit.getOfflinePlayer to convert to the
206   * OfflinePlayer.
207   */
208  @NotNull
209  QUser getOwner();
210
211  /**
212   * Set new owner to the shop's owner
213   *
214   * @param qUser New owner user
215   */
216  void setOwner(@NotNull QUser qUser);
217
218  /**
219   * Getting the shop tax account for using, it can be specific uuid or general tax account
220   *
221   * @return Shop Tax Account or fallback to general tax account
222   */
223  @Nullable
224  QUser getTaxAccount();
225
226  /**
227   * Sets shop taxAccount
228   *
229   * @param taxAccount tax account, null to use general tax account
230   */
231  void setTaxAccount(@Nullable QUser taxAccount);
232
233  /**
234   * Getting the shop tax account, it can be specific uuid or general tax account
235   *
236   * @return Shop Tax Account, null if use general tax account
237   */
238
239  @Nullable
240  QUser getTaxAccountActual();
241
242  /**
243   * Gets shop status is stacking shop
244   *
245   * @return The shop stacking status
246   */
247  boolean isStackingShop();
248
249  /**
250   * Get shop is or not in Unlimited Mode (Admin Shop)
251   *
252   * @return yes or not
253   */
254  boolean isUnlimited();
255
256  /**
257   * Set shop is or not Unlimited Mode (Admin Shop)
258   *
259   * @param paramBoolean status
260   */
261  void setUnlimited(boolean paramBoolean);
262
263  /**
264   * Gets the benefit in this shop
265   */
266  @NotNull
267  BenefitProvider getShopBenefit();
268
269  /**
270   * Sets the benefit in this shop
271   */
272  void setShopBenefit(@NotNull BenefitProvider benefit);
273}
